text:

Yeah!

...Ｉ'm here.

Yes!

On it!

Yes, sir! All ships, prepare for battle!
Ｆorm battle lines!

Charge!!

Albuquerque! Lead the vanguard!
...Yes, sir.

FO, the fleet that's been

Aye!!

Aye!

Angel! Bring us around behind their

You got it!!!

Heh, what a thrill. Listen up, boys!!!

Aye!!!

Ｆinally found you! This time, we

Keee-hee-hee! Who are yooou? Have

...M-maybe Ｉ shouldn't get involved...

Kee-hee-hee! Ｉ'll sink you! Ｉ'll sink

One thing after another, isn't it...?
Eek!! Pirates are the worst!

Easy prey!
Damn you!

Ｉ'll never make anything of myself if

Everyone! Battle stations!

Yeah! That's what Ｉ've been waiting

FI, the enemy has quite a few

You dare defy me, Pedro de Valdes?

Albuquerque! Lead the vanguard!
...Yes, sir.
...This... was for the best...
...Admiral Albuquerque...

Let's tell the king in Lisbon and

Great idea! We'll get a huge reward!

...Damn it! Ｉ lost! Just my luck!
Vels!
G-Gerhard...!

Give it a rest?!

Of course! Discipline and thrift? What

...That's why you're a fool!
What?!

You may not know it, but your

Then how could you beat me?

That's how little you understand!
Greed has corrupted your heart and

Ｉ taught you when we first met!
Strength comes from the heart, more

That's why Ｉ taught you discipline

Why can't you understand that?!

And Ｉ'm telling you, Ｉ can't stand
it! You may be a lion, but you're an
old lion whose time has passed!

Ｉ take what Ｉ want and crush anyone

Ｉ was a fool to try to reason with

Ｆine! Ｉ never thought of myself as

Ugh...
Gerhard...

Ｉ'm sorry you had to see that. Ｉ

bring myself to do it.

Still, he was my pupil. Please forgive
me...
No, don't worry.

And what you said, Gerhard... That
strength comes from the heart, more
than from skill or muscle. Ｉ think
you're absolutely right...

Thank you. Ｉt helps to hear you say
that...
We won.
Heh, easy!

...So many lives lost at sea. Or perhaps
Ｉ should say, returned to Mother Sea...
Manuel...?
Let's soothe the souls of the fallen.

"The sea and a mother are alike. The
lapping waves sound strangely familiar,
as though awakening the distant
memory of a mother's heartbeat.

The sea and a mother are alike. Ｉn
foreign lands, they say, one sound, one
written word may stand for both.

The sea and a mother are alike. Each
holds us in a bond that cannot fade
for as long as we live."

Manuel... You're a poet. That was

Yeah, it was. Ｉ thought you were just
some old fellow who loved ships.
You've got real talent.

...The sea welcomes everything. Ｉ hope
we can do the same.

Damn, lost again... But next time...
Huh?!
Sorry, but there is no next time.
Heh heh heh.
What?! Say that again!
Huh? Didn't hear me?
Nobody here listens to you anymore!
Damn you! Traitors!!

Hey, FI! Something's happening
over there!

Looks like they've surrounded that
pirate captain...
A mutiny? Let's get closer.

We've done nothing but lose lately,
and we haven't made a thing. Time
you paid for that.
Paid...?

Why do we keep chasing
FO?

Heh. Got a reason you can't tell the
rest of us, don't you?!

All you want is to get the Bloodstained
Shamshir back from FO.
Ｉt's your dead father's keepsake!
That's... Ｉt wasn't like that...

You've lost your touch. Nobody wants
a boss who can't make money. Say
your prayers!
Hear that, FI? They'll kill her!
Ｉ'll go.
A-Al...
What do you want? Stay out of this!
...Know your place.

None of your business! ...Might as well
finish him off with Aziza!
Al, Ｉ shall fight at your side.

Me too! Men who rely on numbers are
the worst!
Don't forget me!
...Pirates! Come on, all of you!

Why...? Why fight for me? We were
enemies moments ago...
D-damn it! The odds are against us!
Wait!
FI FA...
You got business with her, too?
Yes. Let's settle this by talking.
FI! They won't listen to reason!
Relax, Clau. Think they can beat us?
No chance.

Then it'll be fine. They don't have
another choice.
Damn... All right, we'll listen.

You no longer want Aziza as your
captain, correct?
Nobody aboard wants to follow her.
Then...

H-hey, FI! Y-you aren't thinking
of hiring these thugs, are you?!
Come on, Clau. Aziza is joining us.

...Ｆine by me. But she's put us
through hell. We deserve something for
our trouble.
You want money?!
...How much do you need?
Let's call it 1,000,000 gold.

That settles it, then. Come over here,
Aziza.
But...
We're done here. So long!

Betrayed by my own crew... How far
Ｉ've fallen. But why did you save me?
Had no choice...
We couldn't leave you.

Besides, you let us escape at the tavern
in Basra. Ｉ've been wondering... Do
you mind if Ｉ ask why you became a
pirate?

...My father was a pirate. Ｉ'm a
pirate's daughter.

Those men all served under my father.
Ｉ grew up watching them, copying
their swordplay and learning the pirate
trade.
Your father?

He died in an accident. That sword was
his, and vanished with him...
The Bloodstained Shamshir...
So that's why you praised my sword.

Ｉ wanted to be a great pirate, like my
father. Ｉ copied everything he did...

So when Ｉ found out you had his
sword, Ｉ had to get it back. Ｉ
thought...

Ｉ thought it would prove Ｉ was
getting closer to being like him. Heh...
But then...

Ｉ realized Ｉ wanted something to
remember my father by more than Ｉ
wanted to be a great pirate...

No wonder they abandoned me. Ｉ was
chasing something that wouldn't make

...Still want to be a pirate?

Ｉ wasn't chasing a pirate's life. Ｉ
was chasing my father. Ｉ'm leaving

Then come with us! Life at sea suits
you better than life on land, doesn't
it?
Me, with you...? Really?
Sure!

Thank you... Ｉ'll work as hard as Ｉ

And just call me Aziza.
She says you saved her life, FI.

Oh, you're exaggerating! We've helped
each other. Anyway, welcome aboard...
Aziza!

We're pulling out for now! Next time,
Ｉ'll finish you!
...Ｉs she going to come back...?
Ｉ think we drove them off...

Tch. We'll withdraw, but next time

...Remember my name: Aziza
Nurennahar!
Yeah, don't come back!

A woman pirate captain... There was
something different about her...
Well? Ready to kneel before me?!

Ugh... Next time, things'll be different!
Everyone, retreat!

Running with your tails between your
legs, cowards!
They got away!
This is bad! Run!

Ｉ underestimated her... She's much
stronger than Ｉ thought.

You thought you could beat me? Next
time, prepare to die!
Caught you!

Ow, ow! A-all right, Ｉ give up! Ｉ'll

Damn you! Don't touch me! Mmph!
Got him! Send him to Hangzhou!
Ow, ow! Ｉ-Ｉ'm sorry...
Behave until we reach Malacca.
Y-you're strong...
Keee! Curse you! Curse you! Curse you!

D-damn you... Kill me!

The Algiers pirates?

Pirates!

Sir!!

Ah?!

(Huh. Arcadius has a good head for

Dock staff handle resupply for you.

Ready?

Let's look at the deck.

A skilled helmsman can quickly
maneuver the ship into a favorable

The mate helps the crew tire less

A Surveyor lets you sail automatically
and shows the fleet's latitude and
longitude.

The lookout reports who ships serve
and how nearby towns fare.

Those posts are enough to sail.
Experiment with the others yourself.

Press + and choose Deck, the second
button from the left. You can change
navigator assignments there.

＜Claudio＞
Come on. You'll see when we get there.

By the way, FI...
what do you think of sailors?

＜FI＞
Hmm... That's hard to answer...

＜Claudio＞

Prince Henry, Duke Leon... Amazing!

＜Claudio＞
The sea is the greatest adventure!

＜FI＞
Here he goes...

＜FI＞
How are we supposed to go to sea

＜Claudio＞
Not a romantic bone in your body!
Can't a man dream?

＜Claudio＞
And... we're here!
Ah, there you are...
A ship...

Well? Surprised?

Behold: the Carteira!

She was an old wreck. Janus helped me

We can't sail yet, but someday, when

Let's go.
What?
Huh?

Claudio? We can ask Julio
